journey.name: ring choice rows
journey.description:
The Pubky Ring choice screen lists one row per Ring identity as soon as Ring answers, each showing its truncated public key, and fills in a row's name when that row's profile lookup finishes. While a row's lookup runs, a spinner takes the place of its avatar, so a row still looking up can be told apart from a row whose identity has no profile. Tapping a row adopts that identity: only the tapped row shows a spinner, in place of its key icon, and every row is disabled until the adoption ends.
Precondition (not a listed capability): Pubky Ring (package app.pubkyring) installed on the same device with at least two identities, at least one of them with a published profile name. Bitkit reads Ring's shared pubky provider only when Ring is signed with the same key as the Bitkit build, so a dev build needs a Ring build signed with this repository's app/debug.keystore; with any other signature the choice screen offers only "Create profile with Bitkit" (testTag "PubkyChoiceCreate"). Also needed: an onboarded dev wallet with Paykit enabled (the default) and no active Pubky identity in Bitkit. The journey adopts one Ring identity, so sign out of it in Bitkit before running the journey again.
On a fast network the lookups and the adoption can finish before the screen is inspected, so the journey slows the emulator network with adb emu; a physical device needs another way to slow its connection. Every row carries the same testTag, so tell the rows apart by their key caption. The lookup spinner carries testTag "PubkyChoiceIdentityLookup" and the avatar that replaces it testTag "PubkyContactAvatar"; the adoption spinner has no testTag. On Android both spinners' accessibility description reads "Loading your profile…". A disabled row ignores taps, which the step after the tap checks.

actions.action: Run adb emu network delay gprs and adb emu network speed edge
Tap the profile button (testTag "ProfileButton") on the home screen; if the profile intro (testTag "ProfileIntro") shows, tap Continue (testTag "ProfileIntro-button")

Verify the choice screen lists one row (testTag "PubkyChoiceIdentity") per Ring identity with no screen-wide "Loading your profile…" message, each row captioned with its truncated public key (its first four and last four characters) and titled with the same key until its name loads

Verify each row whose lookup is still running shows its key icon and a spinner (testTag "PubkyChoiceIdentityLookup") in place of its avatar. If every row already shows its avatar, the lookups finished first: report "already resolved" rather than failing

Wait up to a minute and verify each identity with a published profile now shows its profile name as the row title, keeping its truncated key caption, while an identity without a profile keeps the truncated key as its title

Verify no row shows the lookup spinner (testTag "PubkyChoiceIdentityLookup") any more: every row shows its avatar (testTag "PubkyContactAvatar"), either its profile picture or the first character of its title
Tap the row of an identity with a published profile name
Verify only the tapped row shows a spinner, in place of its key icon, while it keeps its avatar (testTag "PubkyContactAvatar"), and every row (testTag "PubkyChoiceIdentity") is disabled
Tap a different row and verify nothing changes: the spinner stays on the first row and no second adoption starts
Wait for the adoption to finish and verify the choice screen closes and the next setup screen opens
Run adb emu network delay none and adb emu network speed full
